title: Fixes for clear turns and popup close button

issues.title: B1 orders ignored
issues.body:
Mark created orders for his assets, and submitted them. 

When he went into adjudication, but the new routes weren't there - they were still the original ones.

The other player's new routes were present.  Did Mark fail to click "Submit Routes"?

Issue happens on Mark's PC for other assets.   Mark was able to submit adjudication.  Seems sensitive to Mark's laptop: UNC3019

Ok.  We shouldn't have "Clear turn from xxx" for the previous history location.
